valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E pre-exceptional ADR EPS viewed at the 12-month target date; 1 DEO ADR = 4 ordinary shares; GBP/USD = 1.3221 on 2026-11-13)

bear.driver: Prolonged North America spirits weakness (-3.6% in Q1 FY27) and margin pressure

base.driver: Flat organic net sales and low-to-mid single-digit organic operating profit growth per FY27 guidance

bull.driver: US spirits recovery plus accelerated productivity cost savings

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY27E ADR EPS of $6.80, the $101.59 close implies 14.9x; the Street consensus target of ~$110.71 implies 16.3x or $6.92 EPS at 16.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.80 (6.7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: North America organic net sales growth and organic operating profit margin

analyst_notes: Following the Q1 FY27 trading update on 2026-11-05 (organic net sales +1.4%, North America -3.6%), Barclays' Laurence Whyatt raised his target to 2,290p ($121.10 ADR equivalent) and kept Overweight. Earlier in 2026, Jefferies' Ed Mundy (Buy, $117) and Goldman Sachs' Olivier Nicolai (Neutral, 2,000p / $105.77) trimmed or held targets, while Morgan Stanley's Sarah Simon stayed Underweight at $83. Note: TD Cowen's Seamus Cassidy reiterated Buy ($120) on 2026-11-17, after the 2026-11-13 cutoff, so it is excluded.
